## Verdict
REVISE — The scope is sound, but temporal attribution and audit-specific validation need tightening.

## Critical gaps
None.

## Important improvements
- The P&L formula assumes zero opening holdings. For calendar-era attribution, subtract opening marked inventory, preserve existing entitlements and FIFO lots, and reconcile every era—not merely the full run—to its equity change.
- Define any medium/high-volatility groups from training-only or decision-known volatility. Old/new membership and full-evaluation volatility must not substitute for volatility-state definitions.

## Validation gaps
- Add workspace-only, hand-calculated fixtures covering unpaid dividends, PAY after sale, partial FIFO exits, terminal lots, and fee refunds that receive same-day carry but no preceding overnight accrual.
- Bind evaluation predictions to the decision-year model; verify training-label exits against its cutoff, reproduce saved forecasts, and check H3 entry/exit indexing and immature-tail exclusions. Report **distinct**, not independent, dates; overlapping labels and cross-asset dependence remain.
- Before importing frozen implementation snapshots, disable bytecode writes. Compare file inventories and hashes for **every** sealed input/run/model root afterward, detecting added files as well as modified ones.

## Recommended revision
Specify the two attribution/grouping contracts, add the listed checks, then execute the remaining plan unchanged.

## Acceptance Contract
Acceptance level: attested
